dimensions.name: Product Quality
dimensions.description: Correct, complete, consistent and usable public research across seven windows.
dimensions.measurement: Product Quality Gate pass rate plus unresolved natural production defects.
dimensions.evidence: AI-DEV-185–194 consolidated public contracts; natural verification remains pending.

dimensions.name: Decision Explainability
dimensions.description: Users can understand actions, confidence, outcomes and unavailable states.
dimensions.measurement: Public localization, reason, distance, prediction and next-action validator results.
dimensions.evidence: Shared presentation and lifecycle explainability validators pass on deterministic replay.

dimensions.name: Data Truthfulness
dimensions.description: Observed, stale, unavailable and inferred data are not conflated.
dimensions.measurement: Freshness, unavailable semantics and outcome truthfulness gates.
dimensions.evidence: TW and US observed-market and prediction-versus-trade contracts are validator-protected.

dimensions.name: Evidence Traceability
dimensions.description: Decisions retain source, time, snapshot, revision and payload identity.
dimensions.measurement: Provenance, source binding and transition identity coverage.
dimensions.evidence: Notification provenance, archive identity and lifecycle transition evidence gates pass.

dimensions.name: Cross-window Continuity
dimensions.description: Plans and outcomes retain ownership and identity across TW and US windows.
dimensions.measurement: Per-symbol source-plan and lifecycle continuity validation.
dimensions.evidence: TW four-window and US three-window deterministic continuity gates pass.

dimensions.name: Cross-channel Parity
dimensions.description: Dashboard, Archive, Email, LINE and Operations share canonical identity and counts.
dimensions.measurement: Channel source-hash, symbol-set and aggregate parity gates.
dimensions.evidence: Seven-window cross-feature and notification provenance matrices pass.

dimensions.name: Natural Verification
dimensions.description: Merged behavior is verified in eligible scheduled production batches within SLA.
dimensions.measurement: Verified pending-registry records divided by records requiring natural evidence.

dimensions.name: Regression Risk
dimensions.description: Higher score means lower residual risk across protected contracts.
dimensions.measurement: Required branch, seven-window, archive, landing and post-merge gates.
dimensions.evidence: Branch CI and deterministic cross-feature regression gates are active.

dimensions.name: Technical Debt
dimensions.description: Higher score means lower debt and fewer duplicated contracts or legacy fallbacks.
dimensions.measurement: Duplicate formatter, legacy schema and deferred-governance inventory.
dimensions.evidence: Canonical layers improved, while legacy formatter and validator wrappers remain.

dimensions.name: Phase Completion
dimensions.description: Progress toward all Phase 1 exit outcomes with must-fix items closed.
dimensions.measurement: Closed exit items, health target and natural-verification readiness.
dimensions.evidence: Engineering consolidation is advanced; natural verification prevents Phase 1 close.
